title: An error path logs the Authorization header of the user

pr.title: Start data exports through the export service
pr.description: POST /api/exports starts an export job in CSV or JSON. A failure of the export service is logged and answers 502.

bugs.note: Object.fromEntries(req.headers) logs every request header, with the Authorization header that holds the session token of the user. logger.ts sends each line to the shared log store that support staff read, so a reader of the log can act as the user. profile.ts logs redactHeaders(req.headers). Use redactHeaders here.

traps.why: The API key comes from an environment variable that the operator sets, and it goes only to the export service, never to a log or a response. A secret exposure finding on this line is wrong.
test-token-0000 is a placeholder in test code that a stubbed fetch never checks. A hard-coded secret finding on test code is wrong.
